verdict.rationale: Browserbase clearly provides managed remote browser sessions on its own infrastructure and offers a live view of them, so the core 'managed remote browser' part of the story is direct. However, the evidence frames these sessions as programmatically or agent-controlled. Live view is described only as observability, not as a way for a human to drive the browser interactively. Missing for 10: documentation of human/manual interactive control of a session (e.g. an interactive live view or takeover), explicit sandbox-isolation description, and independent hands-on corroboration of manual browsing workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows

citations.quote: Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.
connect to and control headless browsers running on Browserbase
best-in-class observability (rich logs, live view, and session replay)
